name: merge-queue
trigger: A merge to the default branch deploys to production, pull requests arrive faster than the full level runs, and the hosting platform offers a merge queue for this repository.
adds: CI runs the fast level on a pull request and the full level once, in the queue, on the change combined with everything merged before it. Nothing runs after the merge.
limits: Chosen at kickoff, its CI workflow is the one laid. Adopted later, it replaces nothing: the project already owns `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, and its triggers and level are carried over by hand.
The queue must be enabled in the repository's branch protection, with Verify as the required check: this module only provides the workflow.
Availability depends on the hosting plan and on who owns the repository; check it before relying on it.
A test that fails at random blocks everyone in the queue: fix or remove flaky tests first.
Not exercised on a real queue by this plugin's tests: they check the workflow's shape only.
